trace.output: Brief: Redmond Rovers take control for fan audience in ja

- Redmond Rovers took control through sustained pressure and ball retention, reflected in their 71.2% possession and 79.2% pass accuracy over the last 10 minutes, indicating effective quick circulation from their 4-3-3 high-pressing system [#fact_packet, #78].
- Their high defensive line and aggressive pressing, with a PPDA (passes allowed per defensive action) of 2.5, helped them dominate the field position (95.7% field tilt), allowing repeated entries into the final third (10 in the 8-minute window) and increasing offensive opportunities [#fact_packet].
- Ironvale Athletic’s 5-3-2 low block and deep defensive line limited high-quality chances against them, as seen in only one shot allowed (blocked) despite Redmond’s dominance, showing that Ironvale were focused on defensive resilience and counter-attacks rather than possession [#fact_packet].
- The momentum shift reflects a tactical pattern of sustained high press and quick ball circulation by Redmond to press Ironvale’s defensive setup, but Ironvale remained dangerous on the counter, maintaining their lead up to that point [#fact_packet].

- Redmond Rovers have a momentum index of 0.776 at 7' indicating strong control of the game [#78].
- They made 10 final third entries in an 8-minute window, showing high attacking activity.
- Redmond Rovers had 1 shot with an expected goal (xG) of 0.06 in the last 10 minutes [#78].
- They hold 71.2% possession and a field tilt of 95.7%, dominating territorial advantage.
- Ironvale Athletic leads 1-0 despite only 28.8% possession and one shot on target with xG 0.34.
